title: TuningPlanOutcome
description: Unit U23: the real, immediate result of starting a tuning plan — unlike `TuningPlanSummary` (a later, read-only listing), this is the *only* place a `RECOMMEND_ONLY` plan's candidates are ever visible at all (nothing else persists them anywhere a human could see later), so it mirrors `core::tuning::{TuningOutcome, CandidateOutcome}` field-for-field rather than passing anything through raw.
